notes.title: Dev Update #6: The Radical Reveal Video
notes.notes:
Greetings from The Lazerverse,

Last month was a big one as we announced our publisher and released our Radical Reveal Trailer (RRV). 

But we realised that we hadn’t formally shared it here, or broken it down for our lovely Steam community! So let’s do that!

[previewyoutube=Vh1pQ05PRxI;full][/previewyoutube]

The Radical Reveal Video (RRV)
We put this video together to give our community and the press more of an understanding of what they can expect from Wrestling With Emotions: New Kid on the Block. This isn’t a typical dating sim, in fact, it takes the dating sim genre and completely flips it on its head. 

This game will also push against the common theme in games where you’re the chosen one.  In this game, you’re not the most powerful person, in fact, you’re the least powerful person, and that plays a key role in your journey. 

All in all, the RRV introduces you to three things: 
[olist]
M.E.A.T Stats
Datable Dreamboats
Character Creation
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/c9e3d1eff97d3a4540e71f930e39b401bbf74bdc.png
M.E.A.T Stats

Over the course of Wrestling With Emotions you’ll get to chart your own character’s journey to stardom. As you play through the story, the writing will start to tailor itself to some of your past choices, whether that was making nervous, hesitant choices, or embodying a confident, go-getter attitude. 

One of the biggest choices you can make in the game is your M.E.A.T stats. We did a lot of research into the 1990s wrestling scene and determined that being a good wrestler came down to these four things: 
[olist]
Muscle
Elegance
Attitude
Theatrics
[/olist]
Your M.E.A.T stats will affect decisions that you can make in the game and you’ll also need M.E.A.T stats to win over the affection of wrestling fans and the datable dreamboats. 

Higher M.E.A.T stats unlock additional options in hard-to-deal-with situations, both in the ring and in your everyday life. The bad news is that all your meat stats start at 1, and you’re going to need to pump them up. 

Every week you’ll be able to plan out your time and train to increase your M.E.A.T stats. Choose which stat you want to focus on by visiting various locations across Cuddle Town. These are: 

[olist]
Mrs. Muscles Gym to pump up your bod
Hot Shop to elevate your elegance
Thrashers to amp up your attitude
Drama Queens to increase your theatrics
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/43b41c4791469d3b97d2cb3e2e2b068e48c30431.png

The Datable Dreamboats
While our game has a massive cast of lovable freaks and geeks, the datable dreamboats are our 7 core NPCs that a player will be able to develop the deepest relationships with. 

Each dreamboat has their own M.E.A.T stats, which dictate how likely a dreamboat will be at a location when a player visits it. They also have two additional stats: like and feelings. 

Like is how much you as a player like this character, while feelings dictate how strongly a dreamboat feels about you. 

With higher feelings, a dreamboat may be more willing to give you their number to go out on dates or want to team up with you in the ring. If you push someone’s feelings into the negative, chances are they'd like to put you through a table. 

Over the course of the game, a socially ambitious player could grow close to two or three dreamboats but, as with the original, things ultimately come down to finding your perfect match.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/99ef0373451f375616c4d5f149097dd0d87e20a1.gif

The Character Creator
Identity and freedom of choice are at the core of this game and this all starts with the Character Creator. When playing this game, we want you to really feel that your story is unique and special, so your journey begins with building your dream muscle-person. 

Look-out Lovers (LOL) is our high-tech system, where wrestlers shape their identities, changing their name and appearance in the process. This brings us to Strong Cuddles Magazine. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/016040e4f056bc7d979144150774e3a77ff5195a.png

Right at the beginning of the game, you’ll discover an application form to join Wrestling with Emotions in the latest issue of Strong Cuddle Magazine. 

Filling out the application allows you to refine your character, establishing details like your pronouns, where you're from, what kind of music you like, and your favorite style of wrestling. All of these details are tracked by the game and will be called back down the line. 

The application is also your first introduction to the 7 dreamboats. You'll be asked to pick who you most like, and who you'd most like to punch in the face. These initial choices affect the like and feeling stats of these characters, immediately creating a sense of who the player is and isn’t into. 

Between these choices and being asked to describe your vibe from the very start, the game allows players to start building a sense of personality. Using the stat modifications of these choices, we can then present players with a story and character that feels all their own. 

--

We hope this gave you some insight into what you can expect from Wrestling With Emotions: New Kid on the Block and we have so many other exciting things that we can’t wait to share with you. 

Thanks for reading, and stay rad!

notes.title: Dev Update #5: Announcing the Ultimate Tag Team!
notes.notes:
Yo gang! 

Brace yourselves, because this month's update is a BIG ONE! We've been working hard to create Wrestling With Emotions: New Kid on the Block, but we knew if we wanted to create the best wrestling dating sim ever we would need a little additional support. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/62f43e592023e3f56e20300a82beddc9cb3ea1d6.png

So, we’ve teamed up with the incredible folks over at Prismatika to help bring our dream pro-wrestler cuddling-sim to life! 

They’ll be handling all things marketing for us going forwards so we can dedicate our full attention to making sure that Wrestling With Emotions: New Kid on the Block is the best it can possibly be! 

We’re so excited to be tag-teaming with such a wonderful team and can’t wait to release our game with their support. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/bc8544b385aadf4fa5e6779f5fa3cb365454dc32.gif

We’ll check back in next month with more news from The Lazerzone. Till then, stay rad!

notes.title: Dev Update #4: Introducing Band Hunter
notes.notes:
Yo gang! 

We’re deep in the grips of developing Wrestling With Emotions: New Kid On The Block, but a couple of weeks ago we took a little time out to run with a fun mini-game idea for SA Game Jam 2022.

Game jams have been such a big part of the development of Team Lazerbeam; they challenge us to try out new things and let us take a break from our overarching projects to create a small rad experience for players to enjoy. 

Over the years we’ve participated in SA Game Jam, Ludum Dare Game Jam, and Free Lives Game Jam Island! In fact, the original Wrestling with Emotions was created for a little jam, way back in January 2016! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/00764bce4030629ceb000890d07b0a23c28f0598.gif

When brainstorming for this game jam, we jammed out exploring the idea of a "band scouting simulator" mini-game for our pro-wrestler dating sim. 

In the 72-hour time limit, we wrote and recorded some new tunes, and made up some imaginary bands for you to pick and choose from. Not bad for just two people! 

INTRODUCING: Band Hunter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/1cf8a1f74bb5a17e12dc9c31767272a0aba3fb0a.png

"BAND HUNTER" is a game about listening to tunes and deciding the fates of bands in an alternative 1994! Successful bands will get to play at our in-game skate-park/ club, Thrashers.

Will you give tomorrow's next superstar their first break?

Or will you shatter the dreams of an ever hopeful new band?

Only you can decide!

You’ll be able to play Band Hunter when Wrestling With Emotions: New Kid On The Block releases or you can try it out through SA Game Jam.

We hope you all have a fantastic holiday period and we will be back in January with our next dev update! As always, you can find us on Discord or Social Media if you want to keep up with all our latest news:

Discord: https://discord.gg/9Xh3HAE
Twitter: @teamlazerbeam
TikTok: @wrestlingwithemotions

notes.title: Dev Update #3: Meet The Team
notes.notes:
Hiya!

Greetings from The Lazerverse, and welcome to our latest Wrestling With Emotions Dev Update! 

In making our dream pro-wrestler cuddling-sim, our little video game band has evolved! This month we’re delighted to unveil the new and improved Team Lazerbeam lineup.

There are a bunch of awesome bandmates to share, so let’s jump straight in!

Ben - Art & Words
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/d437ef7ec86b7406106e90e7a40f2711dd72b364.jpg
 Name: Ben Lazerbeam AKA Sassquatch
Origin: South Africa
Pronouns: They/ Them
Finishing move: Atomic High-five
First, let me introduce myself: Yo! I’m Ben, the tallest and most excitable member of Team Lazerbeam! Since we started the band back in 2014, I’ve been laying down the art and words for our games! Wrestling With Emotions 2 is by far the most massive game we’ve dreamt up/ I couldn’t be more stoked to be working with this group of people to realise that dream!

Dope Saint Jude - Words & Music
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/dbb6f3029fc91863369de1213bed0ed338be25d5.jpg
 Name: Catherine AKA Dope Saint Jude
Origin: South Africa
Pronouns: She/ Her
Finishing move: The Mic Drop
Rapper, song writer, producer, visionary. Dope Saint Jude’s musical output has defied genre, and been some of the very best stuff out of South Africa this millenium. WWE2 marks her debut in the world of video game narrative and music. We’re beyond stoked to have Dopey bringing mountains of heart and fire to our world of wrestling weirdos!

Check out her previous work 👇👇👇 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MbY5vmW8GKo

Alex - Words
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/0b4cd2d2fc8a9699e1324f34f5f3eb84de378334.jpg
 Name: Alex
Origin: Russia
Pronouns: She/ Her
Finishing move: Double-cat Dropkick
The wordsmith behind the fantastic writing in Backbone, Alex sure knows how to write some good words for video games! A reformed sand-salesperson turned game punk (who likes cats as much as the rest of us), Alex has been an absolute perfect fit for Team Lazerbeam!

Check out her previous work 👇👇👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/865610/Backbone/

Mars - Words
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/312484d410c6adb8d8b7eeba73ba28117ac2993f.jpg
 Name: Mars AKA Wii_Gay
Origin: USA
Pronouns: He/ They
Finishing move: Pink Slipper Sleeper-hold
Rounding out our gang of wonderful writers, we’ve got the owner of Team Lazerbeam’s best moustache, Mars. Before joining forces on this game, we were monster fans of Mars’s musical output with his band Aye Nako. Between his ripping up the world of DIY music and doing hilarious let’s plays (as Wii_Gay - Check him out!), we figured Mars would be a wonderful addition to Team Lazerbeam!

Check out their previous work 👇👇👇 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UhrzLLKNyEg

Kirstyn - Art and Code
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/7282f5ee505ae6c7b23535c13996af5914ffa260.jpg
 Name: Ben Lazerbeam AKA Sassquatch
Origin: South Africa
Pronouns: She/ They
Finishing move: Panda Punch
Kirstyn Lazerbeam has been working on this game with us since early last year. Initially joining us on a uni internship thing, Kirstyn smashed the look of Wrestling With Emotions into a new dimension, and quickly became a full time Lazerbeam. Her 3D backgrounds have breathed so much life into the world of Cuddle Town!

Caitie - Art
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/ad22bf5b25aa30a5875e5e0208b7c2a14484e634.jpg
 Name: Caitie AKA Potato
Origin: South Africa
Pronouns: She/ Her
Finishing move: Doom Duckie
An illustrator/ animator that excels at bringing the adorable and strange to life, Caitie is the newest addition to Team Lazerbeam, but she’s been part of my chosen family for years. In a distant age called 2015-19, Cait and I worked together as Cool Your Jets. We were ronin artists, creating cute and weird animations for whoever hired us. Fast forward 5 years, and it’s just wild that the two of us have been creatively reunited to spend our days drawing wrestler nipples. What a time to be alive!

Dorian - Production
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/b3fcd38edd0d40bf05fb4aebc89784c40e9e8576.jpg
 Name: Dorian
Origin: South Africa
Pronouns: Xe/ They
Finishing move: Hot Glue Gun
A legendary South African games artist, turned producer, Dorian is the glue keeping this whole crazy katamari together. Having a producer in the band is a pretty radical shift for Team Lazerbeam, and one that we’re super stoked by. Having Dorian in our corner has been life changing! Along with this game, Dorian is currently producing the upcoming roguelike goat-sweeper, Desktop Dungeons: Rewind.

Check out their other work👇👇👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976950/Desktop_Dungeons_Rewind/

Natalie - Code
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/9f3c954b662d10bf39f179930c6056a1909572b7.jpg
 Name: Natalie
Origin: South Africa
Pronouns: She/ Her
Finishing move: Saw-wave Slam
Back when I first discovered Cape Town’s amazing indie game dev scene, Natalie was one of the first people I met. With a skillset that combines programming, art and music, Natalie’s made an awesome string of experimental party games, and breath-taking interactive experiences. On WWE2, she’s creating systems that allow for sandbox style wrestling matches, resulting in chaotic bursts of unique narrative mayhem!

Junior - Music and Sound
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/7ab55119256771a2dbbe517768042d15e4731ff9.jpg
 Name: Junior Elvis Washington Laidley AKA J.E.W.L. AKA Fridge Poetry
Origin: UK
Pronouns: He/ Him
Finishing move: Casio Crunch
Jun is one of my very favourite humans. I’ve had the joy of touring and performing with Jun’s power pop punk band Johnny Foreigner (if you don’t know them, do yourself a favour and check this incredible band out!). It’s super exciting to now have him joining Team Lazerbeam on sound design and music duties. Aside from the brilliant Jo Fo, Junior is also one half of the incredible Yr Poetry and has a solo project called Fridge Poetry. Everything this handsome man touches turns to solid gold, and we’re so very lucky to have him involved in this game!

Check out his previous work 👇👇👇 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R6oFMsQdQWg

Jason - Music
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/512be5f077162acc0ca0cbc8920813166dd2327d.jpg
 Name: Jason AKA J-Booty AKA Drift Prism
Origin: South Africa
Pronouns: He/ Him
Finishing move: Blinding Legs Kickie
And wrapping things up, OG Lazerbeam and man of a million talents, the one and only Jason Lazerbeam. His music has been so instrumental in shaping every one of our games, from Snow Cones, to the original Wrestling With Emotions. Outside of Lazerbeaming, Jason can usually be found absolutely killing it with Cape Town’s Free Lives. With them Jason is currently working on  the upcoming games, Anger Foot, Stick It To The Stickman and Terra Nil.

Check out his other work 👇👇👇 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1978590/Anger_Foot/

Wrap-Up

Whew! That’s it! What a cute gang right?!
And what sort of gang would we be without an official poster?? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/e8319c27ced330c3d7034e1b293e5dbfb3c7f5e7.png

Can you guess who's who? 

I hope you enjoyed this wee insight into the evolution of our game band. It feels so good to finally be able to share all this good news with the world!

We’ll check back in next month with more tales from The Lazerzone. Till then, stay rad and be excellent to each other! 

Discord: https://discord.gg/9Xh3HAE
Twitter: @teamlazerbeam
TikTok: @teamlazerbeam

notes.title: Dev Update #2: Welcome to Cuddle Town!
notes.notes:
Hey Lazerbuds! 

We’re so stoked to share our second monthly dev update with you all. This month we’re going behind the scenes, literally, to show you some of the locations you can find in Wrestling With Emotions!

Yr Home
Make yourself at home! From the wrestling memorabilia covering every available surface, to the weights and photographs detailing your own wrestling journey, your home is a chaotic space where your character’s true adoration of wrestling is plain to see.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/da8fd4699c04f55b8749da3a1be6c0dd0ba0a4ce.png


The Mirror
Who do you want to be? 

In your home you’ll find a mirror where you’ll be able to design your rad wrestling babe at the start of the game! As you level up your MEAT, you can revisit the mirror to modify your muscle cutie! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/ace5a1cc0e6d004bdea8c8a89562d89a5a023634.png


Manny’s Office
There’s no location in Cuddle Town more revered than the office of MC Manny MC Man. As the head of the biggest wrestling promotion in history, Manny’s office isn’t just a huge deal to any rookie, but it’s also a museum exploding with over 50 years of Wrestling With Emotions’ history.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/b666564ec1fd6eec40160284f41820b688c94798.png


Sweat City
Pump it up! Sweat City is the infamous training ground of WWE legends and this is where you’ll come to level up your GUTS (Grabbies, Uppies, Throwies, Strikes)! Learn some stellar new moves in the ring to show them off in your next big match. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/255cc0981979c8ff0154686b8b5b9cd563187d38.png

The Cuddle Dome
At the end of every week you’ll find yourself in The Cuddle Dome and also on the TV of every wrestling fan out there. It’s time to show them what you’re made of! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/ad237965c1b4c02875444dd47852a26c09dd33ac.png

The Locker Room
Deep inside the Cuddle Dome is the Locker Room, where all wrestlers prepare for their matches. This is the perfect opportunity for chance encounters with wrestling superstars, which often results in bursts of backstage drama.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/c4e9c80901876ea83e1a3c91c61d88abcade3cf7.png


And that’s all we’ve got for you right now. But don’t fret, there’s more exciting locations in the works, including spots to take your favourite wrestlers out on dates!

Where would you wanna take your dream date? 

As always, thanks a ton for your continued support. We hope to catch you at our next dev update next month! 

Love and high-fives,
Team Lazerbeam

Our socials: 
Discord: https://discord.gg/9Xh3HAE
Twitter: @teamlazerbeam
TikTok: @wrestlingwithemotions

notes.title: Dev Update #1: The Wrestlers
notes.notes:
Yo gang! Welcome to our first monthly development update. 

We thought we’d kick things off by introducing you to our diverse cast of wrestling weirdos. You’ll definitely want to get to know them as you’ll be spending heaps of time together backstage. 

Ready to meet the future of wrestling? 

Freakshow - The Mutant Swamp Dude
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/49c5cb4f1fc9469a1bc24a39a8b096750c3627f9.png
“Bork bork!” Big, green and completely unintelligible, Calling Freakshow weird would be an understatement. Bursting with bucket-loads of surreal energy, “The Green Machine” is adored by fans and feared by anyone unlucky enough to face them in the ring. 
Pronouns: they/them
Nickname: The Green Machine
Finisher: Bork Buster

Matsuri - Full-throttle Grapple Punk
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/fef5592276eb6d784d07421201c433c56315f06c.png
“Dinosaurs Will Die!” - Matsuri is the youngest of the league’s superstars. What she lacks in physical size, she makes up for in energy twice over. An explosive force of nature, her unbreakable spirit and punk attitude have made her the face of wrestling’s future.
Pronouns: she/her
Nickname: The Electric Tiger
Finisher: PMA DDT

Arms - The Barbarian Sweetheart
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/78611d934605cd87b16774148e6d22c0f8399fd6.png
“It’s Cuddlin’ time!” - Arms is a larger than life superstar, with a personality as big as his massively over-developed biceps. 
Pronouns: he/him
Nickname: The Barbarian Sweetheart
Finisher: Big Crush


King Pretty Guy - Posh Powerbabe
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/585771db9ae783d06c68ba282ed937d3eb79fde5.png
“Bow Down!” -  The ultimate beautiful baddie, King Pretty Guy has firmly cemented their place at the top of the promotion. A cold hearted competitor and red-hot heartthrob, KPG rules over the promotion with a perfectly-manicured iron fist.
Pronouns: they/him
Nickname: The Monarch of Muscle
Finisher: Crowning Glory

Outburst - Magma Mouth
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/611346451b017a49a561964ca7926ebf74ca8320.png
“Things are about to get toasty!” - Towering over all other competitors, Outburst is a mountain of muscle and uncontrollable attitude. A brutal warrior in the ring and an outspoken menace on the mic, she fears no other fighter and never shies away from speaking truth to power.
Pronouns: she/her
Nickname: Magma Mouth
Finisher: Atomic Chokeslam

Radical Ray - Bodacious Badass
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/0b65fc87f17131cc528b18cf34d0b5c4c83b30c1.png
“Too Bad, so rad!” -  Bombastic, bodacious and bad to the bone, Radical Ray is one of the league’s biggest names. While his tubular persona might be out of touch with the alternative spirit of the 90s, he remains a firm favourite of younger fans that love his flashy personality, hard hitting wrestling and breath-taking breakdancing.
Pronouns: he/him
Nickname: The Funky Cyclops
Finisher: Dumping Bummer


Irresistible Steve - The Hottest Thing In The Ring
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/12627d4aa38f6e672db82d32ebef71d63bece237.png
“Hot like pizza supper!” - Irresistible Steve lives by one rule: win at all costs, and look gorgeous doing it. A theatrical fan favourite, he prides himself on living up to his title “ the hottest thing in the ring”.
Pronouns: he/him
Nickname: The Hottest Thing In The Ring
Finisher: Superhot Hot Shot

What a group! Your decisions in game will decide whether you end up their beloved wrestling partners or their bitter rivals. Choose carefully! 

There’s just one person left to introduce you to: 

Big Boss MC Manny McMan
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41001973/b990f1a7936b70301bd24a97bc93ff9308aaf0d6.png
Wrestling runs through the veins of MC Manny McMan. A third generation booker, Manny rocked the boat when he took the reins of Wrestling With Feelings back in the 80s. His enthusiasm and energy are legendary, and above all lives to put on the most explosive show possible.

Unfortunately you can only become buddy-buddy with Manny for professional reasons. But, with 7 wrestling superstars to seduce, enrage or bodyslam, you’re going to be spoiled for choice! 

Have you got your eye on anyone already?  

We’ll be back with our next update in a few weeks! But you can keep in touch with us on Discord or Social Media in the meantime: 

Discord: https://discord.gg/9Xh3HAE
Twitter: @teamlazerbeam
TikTok: @wrestlingwithemotions
